cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.70% · WTI -1.60% · Brent -5.35% · NatGas +15.68%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.61%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.61%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.55%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +6.05%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +6.05%, GEV +4.92%, AR +3.51%, BWXT +3.15%, VRT +3.08%. Laggards: EOSE -5.78%, SEDG -5.04%, LEU -4.21%, ENPH -3.99%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
